newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends barely changed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends barely changed.

text.p: London white sugar futures closed little changed after holding to narrow ranges.
Most of the focus was on switches and against actuals ahead of the March expiry next week, traders said.
March finished 80 cents higher at $300.50 per tonne after trading between $299.00 and $300.50.
May ended 10 cents firmer at $298.50 after also keeping within a tight band.
In Paris, March finished 20 cents up at $299.50 and May was 50 cents firmer at $298.50.
